title: TraceMap - Detector scoreboard
description: The detector treated as a model: offline accuracy from the nightly golden set, online behaviour from what it actually emits. The two together are the claim; either alone is a half-claim. Precision from the eval set is measured against injected faults with known answers; alert volume is the proxy on-call actually feels between runs.

panels.title: Offline accuracy - the nightly golden set
F1
panels.description: Gate floor is 0.82. Below it a merge is blocked, and the fix is the detector, not the tolerance.

panels.title: Precision
panels.description: The number that decides whether anyone still reads the alerts in month two. Alert fatigue is a human availability problem.

panels.title: Recall
panels.description: Reported, deliberately NOT gated. Recall alone is maximised by alerting on everything, and gating it would invite exactly that trade.

panels.title: MTTD p95
panels.description: Measured by injecting known faults, not estimated. Ceiling is 432s, which is the pipeline's own worst case - the detector cannot be faster than the data reaching it. Computed over DETECTED cases only; the two null cases contribute no latency.

panels.title: Hours since last eval
panels.description: A quality gate that stopped running is a quality gate that passes everything.

panels.title: Score drift
panels.description: The reason eval_runs is keyed by git SHA and stores detector_cfg as JSONB: any move in this line is attributable to a config change or it is drift, and without the config recorded alongside the score there is no way to tell which.

panels.title: Detection latency
panels.description: p50 and p95 across the golden set. A rise here with flat accuracy means the pipeline slowed, not the detector - check assembler lag before touching a threshold.

panels.title: Alerts per hour
panels.description: Precision's online proxy. Sustained volume above ~12/h is a broken detector rather than a broken application - check the nightly eval before tuning anything, because tuning without re-running the golden set is M8.

panels.title: Detector heartbeat
panels.description: tracemap_worker_cycle_total. The VALUE is uninteresting; its ABSENCE is the alert. A worker that stops without crashing keeps every other surface looking healthy.

panels.title: Baselines per edge
panels.description: The EWMA baselines the detector compares against, on critical-path p99. A baseline that has climbed to sit on top of a known-degraded edge is the boiling-frog failure M6 exists to prevent - and it is visible here before it is visible anywhere else.
